title: FlowInvalidDetails
description: Details of the error flow_invalid: the active version of the flow of a project does not pass the checks of this Gentry, for example after an update.

version.description: Number of the active flow version.

problems.description: All problems of the flow in the order of files and lines: problems of the whole flow first, then the common rules, scenarios, stages, parts, project subagents, library subagents, and files that do not belong to the flow last.
